paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: Controlled project ablation: TP-YOLOv8 reports SGD lr0=.01 from scratch; Ultralytics fine-tuning guidance discusses lower learning rates and warns auto optimizer overrides lr0. Keep optimizer SGD and all previous settings, reduce only lr0 to .001 as a hypothesis, not a paper reproduction.
limitations: Validation was already used to select prior checkpoint and has only six negative images; its repeated use is exploratory and may overfit. Previously reported test and TAD normal probe are consumed, so this run does not evaluate them. No guarantee of reduced false alarms.
hardware_decision: Batch16 previous run failed while serializing checkpoint; root cause unconfirmed. Batch8 saved checkpoints through epoch14. Restart from pretrained after withdrawing unreviewed negative labels.
experiment_purpose: Compare SGD lr0 0.001 against completed lr0 0.01 on the same training data and validation only; start both from identical COCO pretrained weights, preserve consumed test and normal probe until a new independent holdout is available.
